description:
We’re Menasim to the Moon, a multidisciplinary team formed through MENASIM, a nonprofit that brings engineers and other professionals together to tackle environmental challenges.

Our team combines experience in aerospace engineering, remote sensing, data and AI, software development, product and UX, and 3D visualization.

For the CLPS Lunar Mission Browser challenge, we’re developing Moon Watchers: an intuitive, visually engaging tool for exploring lunar missions and landing conditions. Our goal is to make complex lunar data accessible and support informed, environmentally responsible exploration of the Moon.
